args.sql:
WITH fan_risk AS (
  SELECT 
    f.userregistry,
    f.nicklabel,
    r.retreg,
    e.engrate,
    ps.intconsist,
    ps.lastlogdt,
    r.churnflag,
    CASE 
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'None' THEN 0
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'High' THEN 3
    END AS churnflag_numeric,
    (1 - ps.intconsist) * 2 
    + (CAST(CURRENT_DATE - ps.lastlogdt AS numeric) / 30) * 0.5 
    + (CASE 
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'None' THEN 0
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2
      WHEN r.churnflag = 'High' THEN 3
    END / 3.0) * 2 AS rrf
  FROM fans f
  JOIN membershipandspending m ON f.userregistry = m.memberfanpivot
  JOIN engagement e ON m.memberreg = e.engagememberpivot
  JOIN retentionandinfluence r ON e.engagereg = r.retainengagepivot
  JOIN preferencesandsettings ps ON m.memberreg = ps.preferencesmemberpivot
)
SELECT userregistry, nicklabel, retreg, eng rate, intconsist, lastlogdt, churnflag, rrf
FROM fan_risk
WHERE rrf > 3.5
ORDER BY rrf DESC
LIMIT 10;
